excerpt_i18n.en:
Recently, Dongyi Technology announced the completion of a 100-million-yuan-level Angel++ round of financing, bringing its cumulative angel round funding to over 200 million yuan. This round continues to reflect strong capital recognition of Dongyi Technology's "full-stack self-research" technical approach and "superhuman" dynamic performance achievements. Investors in this round include Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Industrial Investment, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuang Investment, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital, and Fuzhuo Investment, with existing shareholder Puchao Capital making an additional follow-on investment.  

As a rising force in embodied intelligence founded just over a year ago, Dongyi Technology has secured multiple rounds of capital support thanks to its "full-stack self-research" technical barriers and differentiated product layout. This latest funding will further accelerate the iteration of general-purpose humanoid robots and core joint module technologies, advance multi-scenario commercialization, and expand its global footprint.  

Full-stack self-research builds core barriers, with a product matrix covering multi-scenario needs. Since its establishment in September 2024, Dongyi Technology has adhered to the vision of "Robot for AI," adopting a "full-stack self-research" core strategy to build closed-loop capabilities from underlying hardware to software systems. This drives the transition of artificial intelligence from "cognitive intelligence" to "embodied intelligence," establishing differentiated industry competitiveness.  

Pioneering a unique path of "general motion control model × embodied body":  
On the software side, the new-generation end-to-end motion control model eliminates the need to break down subtasks, directly outputting robot joint control commands. This significantly enhances motion generalization and robustness, addressing issues like "rigid movements and poor scenario adaptability" in traditional robots.  
On the hardware side, the globally innovative third-generation PhyArc series joint module is hailed as the "hexagonal warrior among joints."
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Dongyi Technology anunció la finalización de una ronda de financiación ángel++ de cientos de millones de yuanes, acumulando una financiación total en la ronda ángel de más de 200 millones de yuanes. Esta ronda refleja el continuo alto reconocimiento por parte del capital hacia la ruta tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y los logros de rendimiento dinámico "sobrehumano" de Dongyi Technology. Los inversores de esta ronda incluyen Haizhu Chengfa, Guangzhou Chantou, Jinyu Maowu, Xichuangtou, Jinshajiang United, Datai Capital y Fuzhuo Investment, mientras que el accionista existente, Puchao Capital, realizó una inversión adicional excedente. Como una nueva fuerza en inteligencia encarnada con poco más de un año desde su fundación, Dongyi Technology, gracias a su barrera tecnológica de "desarrollo propio de pila completa" y su diferenciada disposición de productos, ha recibido múltiples apoyos de capital. Esta financiación acelerará aún más la iteración tecnológica de robots humanoides universales y módulos de articulaciones centrales, así como la comercialización en múltiples escenarios.

items.title: 第五届OceanBase数据库大赛收官：北邮「编程高手」赛队夺冠，探索AI原生数据库

excerpt_i18n.en:
On the afternoon of January 18, the 2025 National College Student Computer System Capability Competition and the 5th OceanBase Database Competition concluded at the University of Science and Technology Beijing. This year's event attracted 1,223 teams and 2,620 students from universities across the country. After over two months of competition, the "Programming Experts" team from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications won the championship and a 100,000 yuan prize, thanks to their comprehensive performance in database kernel optimization and AI application development.  

The OceanBase Database Competition was launched in 2021 and was integrated into the National College Student Computer System Capability Competition system in 2023, recognized as a Class A academic competition by the Ministry of Education. This year's event was initiated by the System Capability Cultivation Research Expert Group and co-organized by the National Higher Education Computer Education Research Association and the System Capability Cultivation Research Project Demonstration Universities, with the University of Science and Technology Beijing and OceanBase jointly hosting. Over the past five years, the competition has covered more than 500 universities and over 11,000 students, becoming a key platform for cultivating core talent in China's database field.  

Currently, large models and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technologies are accelerating their implementation, and enterprise AI applications are placing new demands on data systems: they must support hybrid queries such as semantic retrieval and structured filtering while meeting governance requirements like access control, traceability, and consistency, ensuring AI "answers accurately, runs fast, and operates stably." The industry believes that traditional "search engine + database" patchwork architectures struggle to meet the demands of large-scale applications in terms of latency, complexity, and data consistency, while natively supporting hybrid queries and multimodal retrieval.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 18 de enero por la tarde, la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios 2025 y la quinta edición del Concurso de Bases de Datos OceanBase concluyeron en la Universidad de Ciencia y Tecnología de Beijing. Este evento atrajo la participación de 1.223 equipos y 2.620 estudiantes de universidades de todo el país. Tras más de dos meses de competición, el equipo "Expertos en Programación" de la Universidad de Correos y Telecomunicaciones de Beijing ganó el campeonato y un premio de 100.000 yuanes, gracias a su destacado desempeño en la optimización del núcleo de bases de datos y el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. El Concurso de Bases de Datos OceanBase, iniciado en 2021, se integró en 2023 en el sistema de la Competencia Nacional de Habilidades de Sistemas Informáticos para Estudiantes Universitarios, siendo reconocido como una competición académica de categoría A por el Ministerio de Educación. Esta edición fue organizada por la Investigación para el Desarrollo de Habilidades de Sistemas.

As a benchmark event in the AI industry-academia-research-investment community, GAIR has consistently adhered to the core principle of "heritage + innovation" since its inception in 2016, dedicated to bridging cutting-edge technology with industrial practice.
